title: Collections Values of the Electric Service Agreement Schedules: Notice Thresholds, Notice Periods, Moratorium and Closure
content:
For each Electric Service Agreement rate schedule, the Credit & Collections values below fix when a written disconnection notice may be issued, how long it runs, when a final notice must be delivered, which days and seasons are closed to disconnection, and how long a disconnected account may remain open.

## Values by schedule

Columns: RS is Schedule RS Residential Standard Service, RT is Schedule RT Residential Time-of-Use Service, REV is Schedule REV Residential Electric Vehicle Time-of-Use Service, GS is Schedule GS Small General Service, GST is Schedule GST Small General Time-of-Use Service, GD is Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service and LP is Schedule LP Large Power Service.

| Term | RS | RT | REV | GS | GST | GD | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum past-due balance for a written notice, USD | 100.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 | 250.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 2500.00 |
| Minimum days past the due date of the oldest unpaid bill | 30 | 30 | 30 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Written notice period, calendar days to the earliest disconnect date | 10 | 10 | 10 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 |
| Final notice lead time, hours before disconnection | 48 | 48 | 48 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Notice validity, calendar days after the earliest disconnect date | 30 | 30 | 30 | 20 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Winter moratorium protects electric-heat accounts | yes | yes | yes | no | no | no | no |
| Days an account may stay disconnected before closure | 14 | 14 | 14 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

The winter moratorium period is the calendar window 11-01 through 03-31 (November 1 through March 31, both days included) on every schedule; it protects electric-heat accounts only on the schedules marked "yes" above.

## Days on which no disconnection for nonpayment is performed

- **Schedule RS Residential Standard Service**: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, company holidays and the business day before a company holiday.
- **Schedule RT Residential Time-of-Use Service**: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, company holidays and the business day before a company holiday.
- **Schedule REV Residential Electric Vehicle Time-of-Use Service**: Friday, Saturday, Sunday, company holidays and the business day before a company holiday.
- **Schedule GS Small General Service**: Saturday, Sunday and company holidays.
- **Schedule GST Small General Time-of-Use Service**: Saturday, Sunday and company holidays.
- **Schedule GD Medium General Demand Service**: Saturday, Sunday and company holidays.
- **Schedule LP Large Power Service**: Saturday, Sunday and company holidays.

## Meaning of the values

- A written notice may be issued only once the past-due balance reaches the minimum in USD and the oldest unpaid bill is at least the minimum number of days past its due date.
- The written notice period runs in calendar days from the written notice date to the earliest date service may be disconnected.
- The final notice (phone call or door hanger) must be delivered at least the stated number of hours before disconnection.
- The notice validity runs in calendar days after the earliest disconnect date, during which the written notice remains valid for disconnection.
- The closure period is the number of calendar days an account may remain disconnected before it is final-billed and closed.

## Comparison of the residential and business columns

| Value | RS, RT, REV | GS, GST | GD | LP |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum past-due balance | 100.00 USD | 250.00 USD | 500.00 USD | 2500.00 USD |
| Minimum days past due | 30 | 20 | 20 | 20 |
| Written notice period | 10 days | 5 days | 5 days | 5 days |
| Final notice lead time | 48 hours | 24 hours | 24 hours | 24 hours |
| Notice validity | 30 days | 20 days | 20 days | 20 days |
| Winter moratorium for electric heat | yes | no | no | no |
| Closure period | 14 days | 10 days | 10 days | 10 days |

Hypothetical illustration: a Schedule RS written notice dated on day 1 of a month sets the earliest disconnect date at day 11, ten calendar days later.
